parsed.name: 优傲机械臂夹爪系统
parsed.description: 用于实验室自动化的机械臂与夹爪控制系统，可进行笛卡尔空间直线运动、位置等待以及夹爪开合，适合样品抓取、转移和放置等操作。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory automation robotic arm and gripper system for Cartesian linear motion, motion completion waiting, and gripper open/close control, suitable for sample pick-and-place, transfer, and handling tasks.
